- If both \(a\) and \(b\) are odd or both are even, then \(a + b\) and \(|a - b|\) are both even.

sentence: Since the initial sum \(524800\) is even, the sum of the numbers on the blackboard will remain even after each operation.

sentence: After ten operations, only one number remains, and since the sum must be even, this remaining number must also be even.
